name: Multi-class Classification
learningObjectives: Understand the challenge of extending binary classifiers to multiple classes
Learn the One-vs-Rest (OvR) strategy for multi-class classification
Explore how binary classifiers are combined to make multi-class predictions
Compare different strategies for handling class imbalance in multi-class problems
Interpret confusion matrices and per-class performance metrics
